name: race_strip_my_clock_and_the_rule
description: Tide Race tells how it is won where it is chosen and shows my own clock beside the rival's (playtest halv s1, P10: 'The hub says only Tide Race · 2–4 players · 12 waves'; in the match the rival line read 'Rival Wave 4 · 20 lives · 1:51' and 'My own time appears nowhere until the results'; the persona learned that lives cost time only from the rival's '+50 s'). On the hub, Tide Race's button tooltip and the mode line say design 1.3's win order in a few words from the rules ('the lower time to clear wave 12 wins; each life lost adds 10 s': waves from its wave list, seconds from race.life_t); High Water's say nothing of it. In the match the line under the strip starts with my clock, 'You 0:05', then the rival's; two lives lost add '+20 s' to mine, as the rival's own penalty shows on its side; once the rival's Holdfast falls the line says what wins and my clock goes, since the wave it fell on decides, not the time.

steps.msg: High Water's line and tooltip say nothing of a race

steps.assert: Game.race_rule_words('tide_race') == 'the lower time to clear wave 12 wins; each life lost adds 10 s' and Game.race_rule_words('high_water') == '' and Game.race_rule_words('undertow') == ''
steps.msg: the win order in a few words, from the race's rules only

steps.assert: node('Mode_tide_race').tooltip_text == 'Two crews race the same waves, each on its own copy of the land. The lower time to clear wave 12 wins; each life lost adds 10 s.'
steps.msg: Tide Race's button says how it is won

steps.assert: node('ModeLine').text == 'Tide Race · 2–4 players · 12 waves · fastest clear of wave 12 wins, +10 s a life lost'
steps.msg: and so does the mode line where it is chosen

steps.assert: node('RivalLine').visible and node('Hud').race_clock_line() == 'You · %s' % Game.race_clock(Game.sim.tick) and node('MineTag').visible and node('MineClock').text == Game.race_clock(Game.sim.tick)
steps.msg: my own race clock leads the line
two lives lost add 20 s to my clock
mine before the rival's, on one line

steps.assert: node('Hud').rival_line().begins_with('Your rival fell on wave ') and node('Hud').race_clock_line() == '' and not node('MineTag').visible
steps.msg: once the rival fell, what wins, and no clock of mine: the wave decides now
